population_rule: exact OPEN+CLOSE lifecycle pairs; loser iff sum(deal_net) < 0
sampling_method: sort numeric position_id, exclude prior 40 reviewed positions, deterministic Python random.Random shuffle; worker_a indices 0:100, worker_b 100:200
interpretation_boundary: Loser-only image review is mechanism discovery. It cannot estimate population prevalence, prove causality, tune thresholds, or repair invalid parent history.

bar_indicator_artifact.source: MetaTrader5.copy_rates_range from portable FivePercent terminal on D:
bar_indicator_artifact.clock_note: time_utc is a renderer compatibility name; raw MT5 epochs are aligned directly with lifecycle server-clock timestamps
bar_indicator_artifact.formulas: pandas recursive EMA/RMA approximation for EMA200, MACD12/26/9, RSI14, ATR14 and ADX14
bar_indicator_artifact.fidelity_boundary: Recomputed indicators are visual diagnostic context, not MT5 CopyBuffer parity and not tester tick-history repair. Lifecycle/source are truth.

entry_indicator_features.interpretation: A recomputed FAIL is not an EA logic violation; it records post-run bar/formula non-parity under the already-invalid 98% parent history.
